label: Couchbase Server 7.0.2
type: a Couchbase Server maintenance release that several features are gated on: IPv4-only/IPv6-only cluster options, additional UI-based node-initialization options, standard index storage for Ephemeral buckets, and Search-service server-group-aware replica placement.
evidence: (Note that the **IPv4-only** and **IPv6-only** options are available only with Couchbase Server Version 7.0.2 and later.)
Note that in Couchbase Server Version 7.0.2 and later, UI-based initialization provides _additional options_.
Starting with Couchbase Server release 7.0.2, the Search service supports Server Groups/Rack zone aware replica placement.
note: The highest-recurrence unpromoted version: id in the corpus at round 26 (7 files), and a maintenance release rather than a minor - which is why nobody promoted it: version records get filed when a round is ABOUT a release. Four of its seven files are round 26's own, because a maintenance release is where operational gating actually lands.
